text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hehehe♪ Birthdays are the best. I got so many presents!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: A huge bouquet, a textbook I wanted to read, a custom 3-tier cake from my favorite patisserie♪ And even a coffret from a brand I adore!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Oooh, as expected of Ai-san...! Everyone really went all out!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I also had a present... but hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: A-actually, I tried making a plushie. But after hearing all that, I wondered if something handmade is okay...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Why not? Handmade is great! If Kraft-chan made it, it’ll definitely be cute!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: But but, somehow... hmm... Sorry, wait another week. I’ll upgrade it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eh! You won’t give it today?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! At its current quality, it doesn’t suit Ai-san!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It’s fine, really. What matters is the feeling behind it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nope, not good! I don’t like it! What I give Ai-san has to be the cutest ever!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, you really have your standards. Alright, I’ll wait. I’ll be looking forward to it, always.
